title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
abstract: arXiv:2607.21596v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model agents can adapt to complex tasks by constructing workflows at inference time, but procedures discovered in one episode are usually discarded after execution. Existing skill libraries provide reusable executable routines, but are typically assembled offline and do not grow from the agent's own workflows. We introduce FlowEvo, a training-free framework in which workflows and skills co-evolve at inference time. FlowEvo compiles successful workflows into callable skills, stores them in a persistent bank, and uses retrieved skills either through direct execution or as context for constructing new workflows. It also tracks each skill's downstream utility and suppresses skills that cause negative transfer. Using a shared GPT-4o-mini backbone, FlowEvo achieves the highest accuracy among 8 baselines on the full standard splits of ALFWorld, HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K, and MATH-500. translated_title: FlowEvo：通过工作流与可执行技能的协同进化实现自我进化智能体
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型智能体可以通过在推理时构建工作流来适应复杂任务，但在一轮执行中发现的过程通常在执行后被丢弃。现有的技能库提供了可重用的可执行例程，但通常离线组装，且不会从智能体自身的工作流中增长。我们引入了FlowEvo，一个无需训练的框架，其中工作流和技能在推理时协同进化。FlowEvo将成功的工作流编译为可调用的技能，将其存储在持久化库中，并通过直接执行或作为构建新工作流的上下文来使用检索到的技能。它还跟踪每项技能的下游效用，并抑制导致负迁移的技能。使用共享的GPT-4o-mini骨干，FlowEvo在ALFWorld、HumanEval、MBPP、GSM8K和MATH-500的完整标准划分上，在8个基线中实现了最高准确率。在ALFWorld上，它达到85.6%，比基线高出26.4个百分点。
tldr: FlowEvo提出了一种无需训练、推理时协同进化工作流与技能库的框架，通过将成功工作流编译为可重用技能并抑制负迁移，在多个基准上超越了现有方法。
en_tdlr: FlowEvo introduces a training-free framework that co-evolves workflows and a persistent skill bank at inference time, compiling successful workflows into reusable skills while suppressing negative transfer, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy across multiple benchmarks.
